payload.title: Add the rating UI to the References tab: decision, confidence, thumbs, reason and explanation
payload.description:
In components/newsroom-references-view.tsx, for each pending Reference show the decision and confidence (for example Include, 82% sure) and why it was picked for review, and add a Needs review filter first in the status tabs. Replace the Accept/Reject pair with the Cyclotron review control (decision-flywheel-dd270031) in thumbs mode: thumbs up accepts; thumbs down asks for a reason from REFERENCE_REJECTION_REASON_CODES (out of scope and policy exclusion mean exclude; duplicate, low quality, unavailable, provenance and other mean no label) and an optional explanation, plus a shareable checkbox. Archive stays. Wire onReview through runReferenceCurationAction in components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx, which today drops note and reasonCode for this tab. Ordering: after the data model and the pipeline hook; needs the Cyclotron package release (decision-flywheel-0dafa816).

Acceptance criteria:
- A review from the tab stores the reason, explanation, shareable flag and decisionRelationId through reviewReferenceCuration.
- Items with no decision still work exactly as today.
- Demo mode renders with fixture decisions and no network.
- Vitest and the existing newsroom BDD features cover thumbs up, thumbs down with each reason class, and undo.
